name: kis-trader
description: Playbook skill for driving the kis_trader KIS Open API client under its safety-kernel discipline (search-before-trade, ticket confirmation, reconcile-not-resend).

kis_profile.title: KIS profile
kis_profile.description: Name of a saved kis-trader profile that holds the app key/secret/account. Create one with `kis config`. The MCP server reads credentials from it, so no secrets are stored in the plugin config.

kis_environment.title: Trading environment
kis_environment.description: 'paper' uses the KIS simulation server; 'real' routes to the live server and still requires the MCP server's own real-order gates (KIS_MCP_ALLOW_REAL / KIS_MCP_REAL_CONFIRM) before any live order is sent.
